supersedes_nothing: CLOSURE_MANIFEST.json (V1, commit 6cca770) is preserved unchanged; this file adds results and history.
decisions_recorded: User approved V01b-R as a SEPARATE gate: legacy Method-B 12 conditions = single RF reference family; Native and legacy are not mixed.
Original V01b (legacy vs Native equivalence) stays FAIL and is not waived.
G3 criteria 1-3 unchanged. The R2_aA spurious path was approved as a numerical matching defect to fix (not by widening the tolerance alone) -> G3_v2.
5 new LoS H go to a GitHub Release (not Git/LFS); re-verify SHA/shape/pose mapping after download.
Even if V01b-R passes, stage_B_allowed=false and scientific_PASS=false until V02 completes.

history.detail: criteria 1-3 passed on all 6 sets; criterion 4 (spurious=0) failed in R2_aA: 1 spurious path at x3.7036_y-0.5204, delay residual 5.11e-14 s vs frozen window 5e-14 s (7.2 float32 ulp); same path counted as 1 missing + 1 spurious
delay + departure/arrival direction gate, one-to-one Hungarian assignment; tolerances K=16 ulp32, A=1e-2 rad fixed AFTER seeing G3_v1 (post-hoc, disclosed); criteria 1-3 unchanged

caveats: criteria 2-3 were calibrated on R4_aB; the other 5 sets are held-out
departure-angle residual of reflected paths up to 6.6e-4 rad (anchor B) / 3e-4 (anchor A), cause not investigated

replay.regression_vs_published_7cases: FAIL at 1e-9/1e-12: 309/4200 runs differ (arm A 0, B 76, C 19, D 214), worst rel 0.017
replay.attribution: same code/inputs/lib versions reproduce the same 309; changing only the OpenBLAS kernel on one machine gives 73/14/209 -> hardware (BLAS-kernel) sensitivity amplified by gating; not a pipeline difference

split_states.G7_FILTER_BITWISE_REPLAY: same environment PASS (4200/4200 byte-identical traces); across environments FAIL (309/4200 vs published, 296 kernel swap, 304 +-1ulp input noise)
split_states.G7_FILTER_STATISTICAL_EQUIVALENCE: PASS under margins fixed before the L3 analysis (after means were known to be tiny); tails: max rel diff 0.41% (kernel), 2.8% (1-ulp input noise)

G7_sensor_v2_inputs.divergence_findings: no gate accept/reject flips in any diverging run; divergence starts near the anchor nadir (median 0.52 m horizontal distance), mostly arm D (s used); earlier gating-flip hypothesis rejected

release_gate.detail: Assets downloaded over HTTPS in this session: SHA256SUMS all OK, release asset digests equal the manifest SHA, downloaded SHA256SUMS.txt and RELEASE_MANIFEST.json byte-identical to the committed copies. verify_release.py stage 1 (SHA/bytes/dtype/shape/finite/rows==poses/rf_poses SHA/pose_id sequence) PASS 5/5. Stage 2 over ALL rows (R2_aB 1303, R4_aA 922, R4_aB 922, R5_aA 1883, R5_aB 1883 = 6913) regenerated from the delivered traces: max rel error 0.0 (bit-identical); min relative difference to a neighbouring row 6.2e-3 -> a pose-order error would be detected.
